recipes.title: Paneer rice box
steps: Pressure cook the rice and dal together.
Saute the paneer and pack it beside the rice.
recipes.store: Fridge in a lunch box, reheat in the office microwave.
recipes.swap: Swap the rice for roti if you prefer.
recipes.fits: A packed lunch that carries its share of the day's protein.
